items.title: No 787s After All? Emirates May Convert Its Entire Dreamliner Order Into More 777Xs
items.summary: Emirates has a sizeable fleet renewal program underway, but it will have to wait several years for all of its new aircraft to arrive. According to ch-aviation data, the Dubai-based carrier is currently awaiting dozens of A350-900s, HUNDREDS of Boeing 777Xs and around 30 Boeing 787s. Of these three programs, Emirates is currently taking deliveries of the A350-900.
